opinions.text:
C. A. 4th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 533 U. S. 928 and ante, p. 1072.] Motion of New Jersey et al. for leave *1125to consider amici curiae brief filed in Mathias et al. v. WorldCom Technologies, Inc., et al., No. 00-878 [certiorari granted, 532 U. S. 903], as amici curiae brief in these cases granted.

Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
